title: PLAT-103-4: sub-route-reports passes its owner to validateApp (required by st audit and startup acceptance criteria; not listed in ticket)

summary: PLAT-103 done. PR #1 (PLAT-103-1): validateApp now throws unless app.owner is a non-empty string; shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking). sub-route-reports also updated (owner: insights) in PR #1, since it called validateApp and st audit flagged it. PR #2 (PLAT-103-2): billing owner 'payments'. PR #3 (PLAT-103-3): core-shell owner 'platform'. All CI and CD green; st audit reports 0 violations. Assumptions: (1) owner values hard-coded in src, matching package.json team, because build.js inlines src and the bundle never reads package.json; (2) libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time, so 'adopting the release' means the apps pick up the new source on their next build, with no registry publish or npm install; (3) reports is not deployed by Jenkinsfile.cd, so its change merges to main but no CD deploy happens for it; (4) empty or whitespace-only owner is rejected too.
